summary: In this Day 5 progression update for his beginner server series, Gorax covers the release of the Child of Chaos banner and evaluates his daily routine. He advises players to focus stamina on Talent dungeons rather than equipment dungeons, as legendary gear farming unlocks on Day 6 along with hero level cap 79 and new talent nodes. He highlights Tavern Gambit for earning Raid Tickets and Legendary Soul Fragments, as well as the Dragon Crown Homage event for acquiring The Dark Lady figurine. Finally, he analyzes Child of Chaos's support role and reviews the PvP and Temporal Vortex meta, where Serpentemis and Toxic compositions dominate.

tips: Spend energy on Talent dungeons before Day 6, as hero level 79 unlocks crucial talent nodes.
Play Tavern Gambit to earn Raid Tickets for instant dungeon clears and Soul Fragments for legendary hero rolls.
Reset Inspiration on heroes freely at no cost to experiment with stat and skill boosts.
Pair Child of Chaos with another support hero to ensure sufficient healing for longer battles.
